paper.$description: Paper — Page background, light-section canvas, inverse-mode text on dark sections

ink.$description: Ink — Dark-section canvas, headline type on light sections, full-bleed background blocks

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body copy, secondary text, hairlines and card borders — the working neutral for content

bone.$description: Bone — Tinted surface for subtle elevation against the white canvas, used for off-white blocks and muted framing

steel.$description: Steel — Muted helper text, caption weight, secondary metadata where Graphite reads too heavy

neue-montreal.$description: Signature display and heading face — weight 300 for monumental headlines at 178px, weight 400 for subhead and body, weight 500 for emphasized labels. The 178px display line-height of 1.00 lets letterforms stack into a typographic block; 0.05em positive tracking prevents the hairline weights from collapsing at small sizes and adds the wide, airy grotesk character that defines the brand.

neue-montreal-variable.$description: Variable-axis instance used for interactive and mid-scale elements — links, icons, navigation, and mid-weight display blocks. The variable axis lets weight, optical size, and slant interpolate smoothly for hover and active states without swapping fonts.

arial.$description: System fallback only — appears in non-brand utility contexts where a system font is acceptable
